## Final Project: Topic and Dataset Selection

For your final project, you'll choose your own dataset and apply the tools
and concepts from this course to clean, explore, and visualize it.

### Dataset eligibility criteria

Your dataset must meet the following criteria:

- **Public availability:** The dataset must be publicly accessible (e.g.,
  from a government agency, public repository, or published study) —
  no proprietary or restricted-access data.
- **Minimum size:** At least [X rows / observations] and [Y columns /
  variables] *(fill in your minimum)*.
- **Rationale:** A short written explanation (3–5 sentences) of why this
  dataset interests you and what you hope to learn from it.
- **Exploratory questions:** At least [2–3] questions you want to answer
  using this dataset by the end of the course.
